regions.today: Dry with a mix of cloud and clear spells, with moderate northwesterly winds, decreasing after nightfall. Temperatures will fall quickly after dark this evening with frost developing.
regions.tonight: It’ll be dry, with a mix of cloud and long clear spells. Cold overnight with frost and some icy stretches developing in lows of -3 to 0 degrees. Winds will be light and variable.
regions.tomorrow: A dry, frosty and possibly icy start to tomorrow morning with sunny spells. Cloud will build from the south during the morning and afternoon with persistent rain following and extending to all areas. Becoming rather windy too with southeasterly winds increasing fresh to near gale force and gusty with the arrival of the rain. Highest afternoon temperatures of 4 to 7 degrees.
